classification.difficultyReason: Clear multiple denominators, collect pronumeral terms from both sides and verify each solution by substitution.

content.prompt: Solve these equations for $x$ and check your answers.

answer.worked:
Multiply both sides by 4.

$$\begin{align*}3x-4&=2x+12\\x-4&=12\\x&=16\end{align*}$$

Check:

$$\begin{align*}\text{LHS}&=\frac{3(16)}{4}-1\\&=11\\\text{RHS}&=\frac{16}{2}+3\\&=11\end{align*}$$

Both sides are equal.

Multiply both sides by 3.

$$\begin{align*}x+6&=4x+9\\-3&=3x\\x&=-1\end{align*}$$

Check:

$$\begin{align*}\text{LHS}&=\frac{-1}{3}+2\\&=\frac{5}{3}\\\text{RHS}&=\frac{4(-1)}{3}+3\\&=\frac{5}{3}\end{align*}$$

Both sides are equal.

Multiply both sides by 6.

$$\begin{align*}5x-18&=42-2x\\7x-18&=42\\7x&=60\\x&=\frac{60}{7}\end{align*}$$

Check:

$$\begin{align*}\text{LHS}&=\frac{5}{6}\left(\frac{60}{7}\right)-3\\&=\frac{29}{7}\\\text{RHS}&=7-\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{60}{7}\right)\\&=\frac{29}{7}\end{align*}$$

Both sides are equal.

Multiply both sides by 15.

$$\begin{align*}5x-60&=90-6x\\11x-60&=90\\11x&=150\\x&=\frac{150}{11}\end{align*}$$

Check:

$$\begin{align*}\text{LHS}&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{150}{11}\right)-4\\&=\frac{6}{11}\\\text{RHS}&=6-\frac{2}{5}\left(\frac{150}{11}\right)\\&=\frac{6}{11}\end{align*}$$

Both sides are equal.

Multiply both sides by 12.

$$\begin{align*}20-6x&=9x+14\\6&=15x\\x&=\frac{2}{5}\end{align*}$$

Check:

$$\begin{align*}\text{LHS}&=\frac{5}{3}-\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)\\&=\frac{22}{15}\\\text{RHS}&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)+\frac{7}{6}\\&=\frac{22}{15}\end{align*}$$

Both sides are equal.

Multiply both sides by 12.

$$\begin{align*}11-10x&=9x-8\\19&=19x\\x&=1\end{align*}$$

Check:

$$\begin{align*}\text{LHS}&=\frac{11}{12}-\frac{5(1)}{6}\\&=\frac{1}{12}\\\text{RHS}&=\frac{3(1)}{4}-\frac{2}{3}\\&=\frac{1}{12}\end{align*}$$

Both sides are equal.
